gaps.title: Synthetic daily data fabrication
gaps.detail: SellerAnalyticsScreen dimensionChartData interpolates orders/views/conversion from revenue trend when dailyBreakdown is empty, drawing fabricated movement.

gaps.title: Hardcoded '0 offers' metric
gaps.detail: Velocity opportunities subtitle hardcodes 'Active traffic · 0 offers' instead of using real offerCount.

gaps.title: Fake status/title fallbacks
gaps.detail: Status defaults to 'ACTIVE', title to 'Listing', category to 'Archival & Other' when data missing.

gaps.title: 2x2 executive card grid silhouette
gaps.detail: First viewport is symmetrical 2x2 grid of bordered executive cards — generic dashboard silhouette.

gaps.title: Rainbow funnel + category mix colors
gaps.detail: Funnel uses brand/success/warning rainbow; categoryMix hardcodes #6B3245/#C9A46A with dark-mode contrast failure.

gaps.title: Touch targets below 44pt
gaps.detail: periodTab, chartViewToggleBtn, productActionLink, listingErrorRetry, adjustPriceButton, productChip all below 44pt.

gaps.title: Charts use system font, ignore reduced motion
gaps.detail: BarChart/LineChart use useFont(null,11) not Inter; animate unconditionally without useReducedMotion guard.

gaps.title: Fabricated merchant status labels
gaps.detail: Falls back to 'Active Merchant', 'Top Rated Merchant', '5.0 ★' when sellerTrust data is missing.

gaps.title: formatMoney lossy + hardcoded GBP
gaps.detail: Custom k-compact formatter renders £1000k instead of £1m, shows £1.0k trailing zero, ignores currency.

gaps.title: Import errors swallowed + misleading status
gaps.detail: fetchImportBatches .catch(()=>[]) hides failures; failed_recoverable/paused_reauth shown as 'In progress'.

gaps.title: Dashboard silhouette not task-queue
gaps.detail: Stack of metric sections (hero + dock + radar + matrix + rail) instead of one urgent-task hero per TaskQueueScreen contract.

gaps.title: Equal-weight 3-column KPI strip
gaps.detail: SellerInventoryMatrix renders equal flex:1 columns — symmetry-by-default pattern.

gaps.title: Raw Ionicons + icon sizes outside bands
gaps.detail: Mixes Ionicons with AppIcon; sizes 11,12,13,17,18 not in IconSize scale (micro=12,xs=14,sm=16,md=20,lg=24).

gaps.title: Touch targets below 44pt
gaps.detail: walletLink, manageLink, viewAllText, OfflineBanner retry all ~38-40pt effective.

gaps.title: ARCHIVAL_SPECIALTIES fabricated and not persisted
gaps.detail: Hardcoded array, selections excluded from hasChanges and handleSave, lost on navigation.

gaps.title: Upload commits to server before Save
gaps.detail: performUpload calls updateMyProfile immediately on upload completion, not on Save. Revert only undoes local preview.

gaps.title: Revert doesn't cancel in-flight uploads
gaps.detail: revertMedia doesn't increment opIdRef or use AbortController; in-flight upload completes and overwrites reverted state.

gaps.title: SharePassportModal fake QR + fabricated trust data
gaps.detail: QR is Ionicons glyph not scannable; AUTHENTIC 100%, default 5.0★, VERIFIED VAULT ID all fabricated.

gaps.title: Decorative passport chrome
gaps.detail: Hardcoded gradient, VAULT PASS badge, SS'26 season tag, ornamental QR brackets, security strip — assembled luxury decoration.

gaps.title: performUpload ignores localUri / uses temp URI
gaps.detail: Upload uses asset.uri (original picker temp URI) not the persisted local copy; retry may fail on expired temp URI.

gaps.title: Touch targets below 44pt + hardcoded sizes
gaps.detail: saveBtn 36pt, tagChip ~26pt, recoveryButton ~21pt; borderWidth:3 and 1.5 not in Stroke tokens; AVATAR_SIZE=96/64 not in AvatarSize tokens.

gaps.title: Dead route param + dead code
gaps.detail: EditProfile route accepts focus?:'avatar'|'cover' but screen never reads it; unused CachedImage import; unused avatarCopy/photoTitle/photoHint styles.

gaps.title: Charts use system font not Inter
gaps.detail: BarChart and LineChart useFont(null,11) — axis labels render in system font.

gaps.title: Chart animations ignore reduced motion
gaps.detail: BarChart/LineChart animate 400ms unconditionally.

gaps.title: ChartTooltip shadow not from Elevation tokens
gaps.detail: Inline shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/elevation values.
